messages:
Maya Kaur: Nightly billing-import failed - NetSuite rejected row: 'line_description too long'. Retry created 2 duplicate Stripe drafts. Need quick mitigation + cleanup.

billing-runner-bot: [alert] billing-import-nightly job 1765009999 FAILED: NetSuiteImportError LINE_DESC_TOO_LONG batch=ns-batch-20251212-02

James Patel: Can you paste one offending invoice payload? want to see which field expanded.

Maya Kaur: sample payload (redacted):
```json
{
  \"stripe_invoice_id\": \"in_5Lmno...\",
  \"customer\": \"cus_B1c2...\",
  \"lines\": [{
    \"amount\": 30000,
    \"description\": \"Pro plan + addons; notes={\\\"deploy\\\":\\\"prod:service-99;commit=b4f9c3e;trace=very-long-stack-trace...\\\"}\",
    \"quantity\": 1
  }],
  \"metadata\": {\"period\":\"2025-12-11\"}
}
```

Sam R.: Root cause: recent change in usage-report (commit b4f9c3e) started concatenating full deploy metadata into line description. NetSuite limit is 200 chars; our import retries on failure and Stripe drafts are recreated.

Eli Torres: Short-term: truncate descriptions before creating Stripe lines / NetSuite CSV. Quick patch:
```py
MAX=200
d=desc[:MAX-3]+\"...\" if len(desc)>MAX else desc
```
Deploy asap to stop retries. Long-term: move verbose info to invoice.metadata.

Maya Kaur: I'll apply a staging hotfix and run the import. If green, promote to prod in emergency window and manually void duplicate drafts in Stripe.

Ana Gomez: Open a ticket and loop in Accounting. Need dollar impact and reconciliation plan by EOD. Also record who approved hotfix.

Maya Kaur: Created FIN-2025-520. Impact: 2 duplicate drafts = $980 total. NetSuite rejected so no posted invoices; revenue recognition unaffected. Cleanup plan in ticket: 1) hotfix to stop retries, 2) re-run NetSuite import for ns-batch-20251212-02, 3) void Stripe drafts, 4) post reversal journal if any duplicates posted.

billing-runner-bot: [info] billing-import-nightly job 1765010200 STARTED

Maya Kaur: Staging hotfix applied at 1765010250, staging import OK. Pushing prod deploy now: https://deploys.redwood/prod/12987

billing-runner-bot: [info] billing-import-nightly job 1765010300 STARTED

Maya Kaur: Prod run finished at 1765010318 SUCCESS. No new duplicates. Manually voided 2 Stripe drafts and confirmed NetSuite accepted re-run. Accounting acknowledged FIN-2025-520.

Ana Gomez: Thanks. Please follow up with a short postmortem in the ticket (owner: eng-payments) covering why metadata ended up in description and CI guardrails to prevent regressions.
